newsitem.title: USA: American Telecasting to appeal delisting.
newsitem.headline: American Telecasting to appeal delisting.

text.p: American Telecasting Inc said Monday that July 25 had been set as the date for a hearing on the company's appeal of the Nasdaq Stock Market's intention to delist its stock.
The company said that its Class A common stock will continue to be listed on Nasdaq until the Nasdaq review committee issues its decision, which is expected within a week after the hearing.
If the appeal were unsuccessful, the Class A common stock would be delisted, the company said.
American Telecasting announced earlier this month that Nasdaq planned to delist its stock because it did not satisfy the listing criteria.
